segments.he: בזה"ל אמר רבינו ז"ל "עס איז אגרוסער סוד אין דער וועלט מען עסט" אין מע ארביט אומזיסט וסיפר ע"ז המשל וכו'.
segments.en: Concerning the holy Tzaddik Reb Yitzchak Leib the Great, a disciple of Rabbainu — who had previously been a great performer of wonders, using practical Kabbalah, famous throughout the world for this. The holy Tzaddik Reb Nachum of Chernobyl heard of him, passed through his town on a journey, and caused him to fall into a great spiritual descent.
